authority: Design audit only; implementation follows independently accepted DESIGN_REVIEW2; zero main or runtime mutations
findings_addressed: TG-DESIGN-01: Authenticated numeric (bot_id, chat_id, sender_user_id) origin; private ledger authority
TG-DESIGN-02: Concrete canonical per-request Sa-plan task lifecycle with immutable server-side binding
TG-DESIGN-03: Power-loss durability with WAL synchronous=FULL and ordered batch-prefix watermark
TG-DESIGN-04: Process lock and runtime:telegram-bridge coordinator singleton fencing
TG-DESIGN-05: Durable outbox responses with chunk identities and UNCERTAIN delivery reconciliation (no blind retry)
TG-DESIGN-06: Truthful preserved directives (EV-93 ceiling, UNOBSERVED projections, explicit mutation/approval refusal)
TG-DESIGN-07: Privacy redaction, 0600 ledger permissions, bounded queues, and legacy Zenoh containment
TG-DESIGN-08: Finite staged operational cutover, durable recovery, and deterministic test falsifiers

tg_design_01_authenticated_origin.numeric_identity_rule: Authentication strictly requires exact numeric triplets: (bot_id: Int, chat_id: Int, sender_user_id: Int). Usernames and first_names are informational display labels only and are never used for authentication decisions.
tg_design_01_authenticated_origin.unsupported_forms_policy: Updates lacking an authenticated sender_user_id (channel_post, anonymous admin posts, sender_chat) or un-allowlisted IDs are rejected fail-closed with minimal tombstone logging in SQLite.
tg_design_01_authenticated_origin.private_ledger_authority: The private SQLite ledger (state.sqlite3) is the sole authoritative store for identity, message text, and execution state. Zenoh notifications, if enabled, carry only opaque ledger IDs (update_id); content, origin, and leases are resolved strictly from the private ledger.
tg_design_01_authenticated_origin.callback_policy: Inline callbacks are authenticated by (chat_id, user_id, message_id, purpose). Unauthenticated callbacks or mutating approval callbacks without reviewed 2oo3 quorum logic refuse execution fail-closed.

lifecycle_flow: 1. Intake: Inbound message assigned deterministic request_id: req-tg-<update_id>-<hash>.
2. Binding Creation: Service creates an immutable server-side TaskBinding for the request, eliminating process-global environment races.
3. Sa-plan Task Lifecycle: For direct reads (/tool query_doctor, /tool query_saplan), service checks task state and live coordinator task_resource.
4. Fenced Execution: direct_read_dispatch evaluates pre-fence, runs read tool with strict {} args, and evaluates post-fence with clock continuity check.
5. Bound Plan Scope: query_saplan strictly queries the service's configured bound plan (uos/telegram-admission/20261001-1015 or canonical root plan), never arbitrary caller SQL.
6. Crash Reconciliation: On restart, uncompleted tasks in SQLite are reconciled with Sa-plan states without fabricated completion.

tg_design_03_durability_and_watermark.wal_durability: All database writer connections enforce PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL; and PRAGMA synchronous = FULL;, guaranteeing zero transaction loss across OS crashes or power failures.
tg_design_03_durability_and_watermark.batch_prefix_watermark: Watermark advances strictly over a fully persisted, ordered prefix of fetched updates. If updates [101, 102, 103] are fetched and 102 fails storage, watermark remains at 101. Next getUpdates offset will be 102.
tg_design_03_durability_and_watermark.rejection_tombstones: Invalid or unauthorized updates are committed as lightweight REJECTED tombstones in the same transaction, preventing infinite re-fetch loops while preserving watermark monotonicity.

tg_design_04_singleton_and_fencing.coordinator_resource: runtime:telegram-bridge (valid resource in session_sync.valid_resource), renewed via coordinator heartbeat with epoch fencing.
tg_design_04_singleton_and_fencing.process_lock: Operating system file lock (flock) on var/telegram/bridge.lock ensures single OS process instantiation.
tg_design_04_singleton_and_fencing.atomic_claim_transitions: Conditional SQLite updates serialize claim state: UPDATE telegram_inbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', worker_id = ?, epoch = ? WHERE update_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'. BEGIN IMMEDIATE spans only localized DB writes, never network IO.
tg_design_04_singleton_and_fencing.in_flight_fencing: If coordinator lease is lost in flight, network dispatch is classified as UNCERTAIN; successor cannot blindly re-dispatch without reconciling previous attempt.

tg_design_05_durable_outbox_and_uncertai.outbox_schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_outbox_ledger (request_id TEXT NOT NULL, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, total_chunks INTEGER NOT NULL, chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, text_hash TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED', 'UNCERTAIN')), telegram_msg_id INTEGER, attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error_detail TEXT, created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(request_id, chunk_index));
tg_design_05_durable_outbox_and_uncertai.send_lifecycle: Payload committed as PENDING, transitioned to SENDING before invoking BotAPI. On HTTP 200 with ok:true, status becomes DELIVERED. On timeout, connection drop, or HTTP 5xx, status becomes UNCERTAIN.
tg_design_05_durable_outbox_and_uncertai.no_blind_retry: Blind retries are barred. Outbound retries require explicit operator authorization and reuse the existing request_id with incremented attempt_count. Already-delivered chunks are never resent.

read_directives./doctor_and_/ev: Reports admitted ceiling EV-93 and explicitly marks EV-94..EV-109 as NOT_ADMITTED.
read_directives./status: Reports truthful service status; reports UNOBSERVED_RUNTIME for unobserved metrics.
read_directives./storage: Reports system NVMe serial safety lock [REDACTED_SYSTEM_OS_SERIAL] without claiming unobserved hardware state.
read_directives./checklist: Reports 18/18 scorecard with live Tailscale FQDN navigation links.
read_directives./plan: Queries bound Sa-plan tasks truthfully via direct_read_dispatch.

mutation_containment./approval: Explicitly refuses execution with truthful message stating authentic 2oo3 quorum workflow is not yet implemented.
mutation_containment./tool_mutating: Direct execution refused (-32002); requires 2oo3 constitutional quorum and Sa-plan task lease.
mutation_containment./zigvm_shell_fallback: Subprocess shell invocation barred under SC-ZMOF-001; returns truthful bounded refusal.

tg_design_07_privacy_and_containment.redaction: Authentication occurs before parsing directives or writing memory. Operational logs contain only numeric IDs and status codes; raw private text is never logged.
tg_design_07_privacy_and_containment.filesystem_permissions: Private ledger directory var/telegram/ permissions 0700; database file permissions 0600.
tg_design_07_privacy_and_containment.bounded_limits: Max message length: 4096 bytes; max queue depth: 1000 messages; retention: 7 days with automatic pruning.
tg_design_07_privacy_and_containment.legacy_zenoh_containment: Legacy shared-key execution and destructive http_delete are permanently disabled. Zenoh serves only as an optional telemetry hint.

tg_design_08_staged_cutover.phase_1_schema: Execute idempotent SQLite migration for telegram_inbox, telegram_outbox_ledger, and telegram_watermark with WAL FULL sync.
tg_design_08_staged_cutover.phase_2_service: Deploy supervised Gleam telegram_bridge service acquiring runtime:telegram-bridge coordinator lease and process lock.
tg_design_08_staged_cutover.phase_3_containment: Quiesce legacy tools/telegram_client.ml polling; route all BotAPI ingress through Gleam ingress guard.
tg_design_08_staged_cutover.phase_4_verification: Execute deterministic unit test suite and verified positive probes.
tg_design_08_staged_cutover.rollback: Stop Gleam service, release coordinator lease; all pending and delivered ledger entries are preserved; zero data loss.

test_falsifiers: TF-01 (Identity): Update from allowed username with different numeric sender_user_id is rejected fail-closed.
TF-02 (Zenoh Ingestion): Injecting valid numeric fields via Zenoh without matching private ledger row produces zero execution.
TF-03 (Concurrent Leases): Two concurrent requests receive distinct immutable bindings; swapping results or IDs fails.
TF-04 (Watermark Durability): Ingest batch [100, 101]; fail storage on 100; watermark does not advance past 99.
TF-05 (Singleton Fencing): Starting two bridge instances admits only the instance with runtime:telegram-bridge lease.
TF-06 (Uncertain Delivery): Crash after HTTP send before local commit preserves UNCERTAIN without blind resend.
TF-07 (Preserved Directives): /status and /doctor never report fabricated purity, false counts, or EV > 93.
TF-08 (Privacy): Secret canary in message text appears nowhere in stdout logs, error traces, or Zenoh topics.
